Welcome to Kings
We are a premium international education organisation specialising primarily in academic pathways for students aged 16-22.
Each year, our students join us from over 60 countries and go on to study at leading universities throughout the UK, US and globally. We also deliver exceptional English language pathways for adults and young learners.

Careers at Kings
We are always happy to hear from enthusiastic and talented individuals who want to work in the international education sector, whether it is in an academic role or a position in marketing, sales or operations.
Work for us
If you are interested in working for us, please contact us through our enquiry form and we'll refer you to the best person to contact, depending on the type of role you are interested in.
Kings is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects staff and volunteers to share this commitment.
Kings is an Equal Opportunities employer and we adhere to the principles of equal opportunity in all aspects of our recruitment process.

Total learning system
Very small classes
Small class sizes ensure personalised, immersive learning is guaranteed.
Your teachers will adjust the way they teach and support you individually based on your CAT 4 report.
The CAT 4 test
We use the CAT 4 test to assess your abilities, academic potential and learning preferences.
The test analyses your ability to reason with and manipulate different types of material. It uses verbal, non-verbal, quantitative and spatial reasoning tasks.
This method helps every student achieve more than they thought possible in a measurable way.
Highly qualified teachers
All teachers are subject specialists. Many hold a second degree or equivalent qualification, including PhD.
Go to the College page and view our teachers' qualifications:
Individual support
You’ll have regular progress testing and skills analysis.
Your subject teachers and class tutor are always available for guidance and support
Academic enrichment
Learning comes alive at Kings through academic enhancement.
We ensure practical, real-world experience complements your class-based study.
